ULTRATE.Cat.acting.Name: Roleplay
ULTRATE.Cat.acting.Desc: Voices, delivery, mannerisms and NPC personalities. Does every character feel distinct, rather than one GM under different names?
ULTRATE.Cat.acting.Also: Voices and tone, NPC mannerisms, Emotion in the scene, Staying in character
ULTRATE.Cat.story.Name: Encounters / Story
ULTRATE.Cat.story.Desc: What hooks you about the story: interesting situations, tension, how the scenes connect. Did you want to know what happens next?
ULTRATE.Cat.story.Also: Pacing of scenes, Combat balance and difficulty, Puzzles and choices, Consequences of decisions
ULTRATE.Cat.audiovisual.Name: Audio / Visuals
ULTRATE.Cat.audiovisual.Desc: Art for characters, items and places, maps, music and sound. Did the presentation serve the scene rather than just sit in the background?
ULTRATE.Cat.audiovisual.Also: Handouts, Journal layout, Music choices, Ambient effects
ULTRATE.Cat.tech.Name: Tech prep
ULTRATE.Cat.tech.Desc: Connection stability and how ready the table is: scenes, tokens, lighting, macros. Did you get to play, or did you help fix the table?
ULTRATE.Cat.tech.Also: Stability and lag, Tidy scenes and journals, Startup speed, Comfort with Foundry tools
ULTRATE.Cat.vibe.Name: Atmosphere / Vibe
ULTRATE.Cat.vibe.Desc: The overall feel of the evening: mood at the table, flow of the game, rapport with the GM and with each other. Do you want to play together again?
ULTRATE.Cat.vibe.Also: Rhythm of the evening, Humor and lightness, Attention to every player, Fairness of rulings
ULTRATE.Rate.Anonymous: Your rating is anonymous — the GM will not see who gave what.
ULTRATE.Rate.Named: The GM will see your name next to your rating.
ULTRATE.Rate.ThanksEditable: You can change it until the GM closes the round.
ULTRATE.Rate.Error.closed: This rating round has already been closed.
ULTRATE.Rate.Error.forbidden: You are not on this round's participant list.
ULTRATE.Rate.Error.invalid: The rating was not accepted — please check every criterion.
ULTRATE.Rate.Error.locked: The GM has not allowed changing ratings.
ULTRATE.Rate.Error.no-token: This rating can only be changed from the browser it was sent from.
ULTRATE.Rate.Error.offline: The GM is not connected, so the rating cannot be sent.
ULTRATE.Rate.Error.timeout: The GM did not answer in time. Please try again.
ULTRATE.Rate.Error.generic: The rating could not be sent.
ULTRATE.Notify.NoRound: There is no rating round open right now.
ULTRATE.Notify.NotIn: You are not part of the current rating round.
ULTRATE.Notify.RoundEnded: The rating round has ended. Thank you!
ULTRATE.Notify.StartFailed: The round could not be started — see the console (F12).
ULTRATE.Notify.Closed: The round is closed. The results are ready.
ULTRATE.Notify.Cancelled: The round was cancelled and its votes discarded.
ULTRATE.Hub.MenuHint: Start rating rounds, read results and trends, and adjust criteria and colours — all in one window.
ULTRATE.Hub.Title: ULT's Session Rating
ULTRATE.Hub.ModuleHub: Open in the module hub (requires the module hub to be installed)
ULTRATE.Hub.Start.Title: New rating round
ULTRATE.Hub.Start.Lead: Fill in the session details and start. Every selected player gets the rating window at once.
ULTRATE.Hub.Start.Name: Session name
ULTRATE.Hub.Start.NameHint: Shown to players in the header of the window.
ULTRATE.Hub.Start.SystemHint: Filled in from the system running in this world. You can edit it.
ULTRATE.Hub.Start.AnonymousHint: On: you see only averages and unsigned notes. Off: every rating carries the player's name.
ULTRATE.Hub.Start.NotesHint: Adds two optional text fields for players: what worked well and what could be better.
ULTRATE.Hub.Start.AllowEditHint: Players can change their rating until you close the round.
ULTRATE.Hub.Start.ParticipantsNote: Only players connected to the world right now are listed. Untick anyone who should not vote.
ULTRATE.Hub.Live.Title: Rating in progress
ULTRATE.Hub.Live.NoteAnon: Anonymous round: you can see who has voted, but not what they gave. Results appear once you close the round.
ULTRATE.Hub.Live.NoteNamed: Results appear once you close the round.
ULTRATE.Hub.Live.AllowEditHint: Can be switched at any time while the round is open.
ULTRATE.Hub.Results.Empty: No finished rounds yet. Results appear here once you close a round.
ULTRATE.Hub.Results.Open: A round is in progress: “{title}”. Its results appear once you close it.
ULTRATE.Hub.Dynamics.Lead: Average rating per criterion across finished sessions. Switch lines on and off with the chips; hover the chart for exact values.
ULTRATE.Hub.Dynamics.Empty: The chart appears after the first finished round.
ULTRATE.Hub.Dynamics.OneSession: Only one session so far — the lines appear from the second one.
ULTRATE.Hub.Cats.Title: Criteria
ULTRATE.Hub.Cats.Lead: The module recommends these five. Rename them and rewrite the descriptions as you like; empty fields fall back to the recommended text. Changes apply from the next round.
ULTRATE.Hub.Cats.Name: Name
ULTRATE.Hub.Look.Title: Appearance
ULTRATE.Hub.Look.Lead: Colours of the rating windows. The default is the Idaris theme from ULT's Loading Screen.
ULTRATE.Hub.Look.ValueColorsHint: As the score rises, the fill shifts from the low-score colour through the accent colour to the high-score colour.
ULTRATE.Hub.Defaults.Title: Defaults for new rounds
ULTRATE.Hub.Defaults.Lead: What the start form begins with.
ULTRATE.Hub.Data.Title: Data
ULTRATE.Hub.Data.Lead: Votes are stored in a private journal entry that only GMs can see (“ULT's Session Rating — data”). Please do not delete it.
